programme.title: Mitron
programme.desc: Jai, an easy-going man, is his father's biggest worry as he wants him to get married and become more responsible. However, things change after he meets Avni, an ambitious MBA graduate.

programme.title: 14 Phere
programme.desc: Sanjay, a Rajput, is in love with Aditi, a Jat, and wants to get married. However, they realise that their parents would never allow it, so they come up with a cunning plan to get married.

programme.title: Omerta
programme.desc: Ahmed Omar Saeed Sheikh, a British terrorist of Pakistani descent, plots the kidnapping and murder of Wall Street Journal journalist Daniel Pearl.

programme.title: Saaya
programme.desc: Akash and Maya, two doctors, are happily married and expecting a baby. However, things take a turn when Maya's bus crashes, and she is believed to be dead.

programme.title: Code Name: Tiranga
programme.desc: An undercover agent is on a mission to avenge the terrorist attacks committed on Indian soil in 2001. Eventually, the mission leads her to a point of no return.

programme.title: Thank God
programme.desc: An egotistical real estate broker comes face-to-face with God after meeting with an accident. Soon, he is forced to play a game that will put him either in heaven or hell.

programme.title: Saand Ki Aankh
programme.desc: Two determined women in a conservative village quietly train in sharpshooting and defy expectations with their extraordinary skill and unbreakable resolve.

programme.title: Khoon Bhari Maang
programme.desc: Widowed Aarti falls prey to Sanjay's vicious plan of getting married to him. Later, with the help of her best friend Nandini, he drowns Aarti and seizes her wealth, but she survives and seeks revenge.

programme.title: Mission Majnu
programme.desc: An undercover Indian spy takes on a deadly mission to expose a covert nuclear weapons program in the heart of Pakistan that could destroy the free world.

programme.title: Saajan Chale Sasural
programme.desc: After Shyamsunder presumes that his first wife Pooja died in a flood, he marries Divya. When he learns that Pooja is alive, he has to juggle between his wives, keeping both his marriages a secret.

programme.title: Yamla Pagla Deewana 2
programme.desc: Dharam and Gajodhar, a father-son duo, claim to be the owners of a massive company to swindle a business tycoon. To add to their troubles, Gajodhar's brother jumps on to the bandwagon.

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: After a cold-blooded contract killer hires him for a driving service, Nikhil, a cabdriver, unwittingly transports the assassin to multiple victims.

programme.title: Beyond the Clouds
programme.desc: Tara inadvertently sets the wheels in motion for a life-altering, unsavoury occurrence after she seeks help from the wrong person to protect her drug-dealing brother from the police.

programme.title: Jawaani Jaaneman
programme.desc: Jazz, a 40-year-old man, leads a frivolous Casanova lifestyle in London. However, when Tia, a young woman claiming to be his daughter, enters his life, he decides to mend his ways.

programme.title: Babumoshai Bandookbaaz
programme.desc: Babu Bihari, a professional contract killer, is assigned a target by Jiji, a ruthless politician. However, during his mission, when he meets Fulwa, a young woman, things go awry.

programme.title: Milenge Milenge
programme.desc: Priya believes she has met her destined lover when she meets and falls in love with Amit, but they soon part ways due to differences. Fate, however, perpetually conspires to bring them back together.

programme.title: Saina
programme.desc: Professional badminton player Saina Nehwal won more than 24 international titles and achieved the top world spot in 2015.

programme.title: Radhe Shyam
programme.desc: Despite being a doctor with no inclination towards superstitious beliefs, Prerana places her love and faith in Aditya, a palmist whose predictions turn out to be too spot-on to be disregarded.

programme.title: Anari No. 1
programme.desc: Raja, a waiter, and his girlfriend, Sapna, hatch a plan to kidnap Rahul, a rich man who is Raja's lookalike. But things go awry when Raja gets trapped in his own plan.

programme.title: Mrs.
programme.desc: Richa, a dancer and an independent woman, marries into the family of Diwakar, a doctor. However, things become complicated when she is forced to adhere to patriarchal standards for a wife.

programme.title: Bharat
programme.desc: During the independent nation of India, a family gets torn apart, leaving an eight-year-old boy who makes a promise to his father to keep the family together.

programme.title: Fukrey Returns
programme.desc: Bholi Punjaban is back with a vengeance for round two of mischief, mayhem, and a get-rich-quick extravaganza with Hunny, Zafar, Lali, and deja choo expert Choocha.

programme.title: Pippa
programme.desc: Balram Singh Mehta of the 45th Cavalry tank squadron steps up to prove his worth by fighting on the eastern front during the Indo-Pakistani war of 1971.

programme.title: Hacked
programme.desc: Sameera finds her life crumbling when her teenage neighbour Vivek hacks into all her social media after she rejects his advances.
